messages.author: c59b667c61f258ae
messages.subject: Re: Field shape plot area
parts:
Hi Martin,

You can creat the plot grid using fieldShape_render (https://github.com/filipematias23/FIELDimageR.Extra#p3)

And count the number of plants using fieldCount (https://github.com/OpenDroneMap/FIELDimageR#p7). However, the function works way better when plants are not touching each other...!

Hope it helps,
Filipe
